basic_info.description: This stylishly updated Bernal Heights 3BD, 2BA single family home offers abundant living space, blissful outdoor areas, & a coveted location one block off of Cortland Ave. Enter via the foyer & head up to the main floor, featuring a LR w/ huge skylight across the hall from the formal dining room w/ original Batchelder-tiled fireplace & built-in cabinetry. Fully remodeled & thoughtfully designed kitchen offers quartz counters, sophisticated glass-tiled backsplash, stainless steel appliances, wine fridge, and pot filler, w/ accent lighting at the floor, counter, & over-cabinet levels. Office nook w/ private balcony and unobstructed southern views overlooks the mature irrigated & landscaped backyard w/ patio.  Two spacious, bright bedrooms complete the upper level each w/ custom closet systems flanking a remodeled bathroom w/ designer tile, glass-enclosed shower w/ an LED-lit niche, large closet & radiant floor heating. The lower level, w/ a separate entrance, offers a 3rd bedroom & family room w/ wet bar, mosaic-tiled bathroom, & French doors to the backyard. Short-term rental ready. 1.5 car garage w/EV charger, storage & laundry. Updated electrical, plumbing, roof, windows. 20+ bars, restaurants & markets within a few blocks. Easy freeway and 24-MUNI access.
